scope: Same current production live-voice adapter, with LUNA_EARLY_BOARD_HIDE off versus on. Three paired synthetic topic changes; condition order alternates. Real Terra and real Jev, local source lookup without semantic prefetch, no bank or grading. STT and TTS are deterministic doubles: first silent PCM100ms after first speech chunk; not actual ElevenLabs latency/cost. Complete trial holds shared provider lock. Tiny sample, not production percentiles.
